subject: Portal onboarding: evidence ownership + quarterly runbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@calypso.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Portal onboarding: evidence ownership + quarterly runbook

Asha / Calypso team —

Thanks for starting the OneTrust/Whistic portal setup call last week. To make the next 60 days smoother we put together a short "evidence ownership" runbook and a stakeholder matrix that maps who on our side will own each artifact (e.g., SOC 2 report, network diagrams, SSO proof). Drafts attached.

Key asks to move forward:
- Can Calypso confirm SSO provisioning window (we usually provision service accounts Monday-Friday 9a-5p PT)?
- Will you accept our signed CAIQ responses via API upload or do you prefer manual CSV/QnA import into your portal?
- Please identify your procurement contact for policy/retention agreements.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Calypso confirms SSO and API preference by EOD Tue (4/13).
2) We finalize the runbook and upload initial evidence bundle to your staging portal (target: Wed 4/14).
3) Weekly 30-min sync for the next 6 weeks to rotate evidence and close remaining QnA items.

I assigned initial owners in the matrix but open to adjustments: Ben will lead portal uploads, Mina will manage SOC 2/controls artifacts, Priyom will coordinate procurement questions with Laura.

If that schedule looks good, I’ll send a calendar invite and open SUP-1289 to track completion.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_ownership_runbook_v1.pdf (draft) | portal_stakeholder_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Manager, Security Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@calypso.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: evidence ownership + quarterly runbook

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear runbook. Calypso Security is fine with the proposed cadence. A couple of quick clarifications: 

- SSO provisioning: We can do service account provisioning Tues–Thurs 10a–4p PT. Please send the SAML metadata and a designated point of contact for our IdP admin.
- Evidence ingestion: We prefer API uploads for CAIQ + SIG (less manual error) but will accept manual CSV/QnA import for smaller artifact sets.
- Procurement: Looping in our procurement team alias (security@calypso.com) — they’ll reach out if any contract retention language needs modification.

We’ll aim to have the portal staging tenant accessible to Redwood by Wed 4/14 EOD. Will that work for your upload timeframe?

Regards,
Asha Kapoor
Head of Vendor Programs
Calypso Payments

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@calypso.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: evidence ownership + quarterly runbook

Asha — thanks, that schedule works. Quick logistics from our side: 

Upload plan (Wednesday 4/14):
- 09:00 PT: SSO smoke test (Jonas + Calypso IdP admin)
- 10:30 PT: Bulk API push for CAIQ + initial SIG sections (approx 250 files, gzipped JSON payload)
- 14:00 PT: Manual verification pass and spot-checks; issue triage queue opened in SUP-1289

Notes / asks for Calypso: 
- Please whitelist uploads from the following IP ranges for the staging tenant — we’ll confirm in a separate note.
- If API auth is via an OAuth client, please send client id/secret to our secure vault (I can provide instructions).

I’ve attached an updated stakeholder matrix with ownership columns filled (minor tweaks).

Attachments: portal_stakeholder_matrix.xlsx

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success — Security Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: evidence ownership + quarterly runbook

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and owners for the record: 

- SSO / IdP point of contact: Jonas Weber (Redwood) + Calypso IdP admin (Asha will share).
- Bulk upload owner: Ben Carter (Redwood).
- Controls & SOC 2 artifacts: Mina Haddad (Redwood) — I’ll upload the latest SOC 2 report and control narratives to the staging tenant and link them in the runbook.
- Procurement / retention: Priyom Das + Laura Bennett (Redwood) will track contract items with Calypso Security.

Action items (open):
- Asha: provide SAML metadata + whitelist IP ranges by EOD Thu (4/15).
- Ben: confirm OAuth/vault instructions before upload window.
- Jonas: send calendar invite for the recurring 30-min sync starting 4/20.

Drive link to the finalized runbook and evidence checklist: https://drive.google.com/redwood/calypso-portal-runbook
Jira to track tasks: SUP-1289 (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SUP-1289)
